coursework.summary: AI use depends on the instructor and academic unit. Law’s default prohibits AI-composed submitted writing even with citation; BSD requires prior approval for graded work; Harris permits assistance only under its listed conditions. Scope: Central guidance with separately identified Law, BSD PhD/Master’s, Harris and History rules.

exams.summary: There is no captured uniform exam permission. Law prohibits GenAI during exams by default unless the instructor specifies otherwise; BSD students should not rely on AI for exams without advance approval. Follow the exact unit and exam rules. Scope: Law and BSD rules are scoped; not a single University-wide ban.

ai_disclosure.summary: Attribute AI assistance as required by student guidance and service/unit rules. PhoenixAI requires citation; Harris requires the specific tool citation and recommends saved outputs. Citation does not make prohibited Law work acceptable. Scope: Central student guidance, PhoenixAI terms and separate Harris/Law/BSD requirements.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Confidential data requires prior review. Follow each tool’s data tier and narrower restrictions. Workspace Studio’s training opt-out warning and the general no-training rule both remain relevant; their reconciliation requires University clarification. Scope: University guidance and tool-specific restrictions; BSD and staff crosswalk scopes identified.

academic_integrity.summary: Instructor rules determine permitted use. College may use imperfect Pangram results as supporting information in a human-led process. College and Harris procedures differ; no automatic AI penalty is established. Scope: Central rules; College-specific process, Harris sanction consequences, separate general Area framework.

teaching_guidance.summary: Student guidance directs students to instructor policies; Law deviations require a written syllabus. History’s default prohibits classroom GenAI absent a statement, and History faculty refrain from AI grading. BSD sample syllabus statements are examples, not universal policy. Scope: Central guidance with explicit Law/History/BSD scopes.

research_guidance.summary: Research data approval must cover the use. BSD scholarly work cannot name AI as an author; thesis/project use is subject to mentor or program discretion, scoped prior authorization and disclosure. Human research contributions remain the student’s own. Scope: BSD PhD/Master’s and BSD-affiliated scholarly work; central data guidance is broader.

security_procurement.summary: Tools handling confidential data require review even when free. Paid tools use Procurement; free research/staff use has specified review conditions. A Risk Acceptance Letter may document agreed risks, not waive compliance prohibitions. Scope: Central tool review and procurement conditions.

approved_tools.summary: The official table lists tools with data, purpose and procurement conditions. Student licence eligibility and vendor prices are not established by a table label; check the particular service and assessment rules.

named_ai_services.summary: The official table lists tools with data, purpose and procurement conditions. Student licence eligibility and vendor prices are not established by a table label; check the particular service and assessment rules.

policy_presence.summary: Official policy/guidance sources exist; this does not establish complete policy coverage or a uniform assessment permission.
